passos.texto: From {carreira.astcon.inicio} to {carreira.astcon.fim}, at {carreira.astcon.empresa}, he ran the full HR & payroll cycle for **{empresasClientes} client companies**, including Brazilian payroll filings. He also worked on the accounting side and supported the firm’s other departments.
passos.extra: He coordinated the team, became the in-house go-to person for technical questions, and trained new hires.

passos.texto: At {carreira.novomexico.empresa}, he provided general administrative support to a large irrigation project: **he helped coordinate in-house teams and contractors**, ran meetings, monitored the work, and assisted with finance.
At {carreira.zen.empresa}, a group of more than {empresasGrupoBase} companies, he built **several internal systems that are now in production**.
passos.extra: The ones published on GitHub appear in the projects below, marked “In production.”

passos.texto: Anyone who has spent five years inside spreadsheets knows where they break: disconnected files, manual reconciliations, deadlines that depend on someone’s memory. **He speaks the language of both the finance team and the tech team.**

itens: Full HR & payroll cycle for {empresasClientes} client companies: hiring, terminations, vacation, severance, and Brazilian payroll filings (INSS, FGTS, eSocial, DCTFWeb).
Also worked on the accounting side and supported the firm’s other departments.
Coordinated the team; served as the in-house go-to for technical questions and trained new staff.
General administrative support for a large irrigation project.
Helped coordinate in-house teams and contractors; ran meetings, monitored the work, and assisted with finance.

zen.tipo: a group of more than {empresasGrupoBase} companies
itens: Built several internal systems that are now in production.
Controllership and reconciliation, internal controls, and AutoSystem ERP.

projetos.texto: **Every one of them started with a real problem he faced at work.** Each is shown as a product in its own scene: what it solves, its screens, the numbers with their source, and where to try it. Projects marked “In production” are in use at Grupo Zen.
projetos.marca: His systems are signed **{marca}**, his own brand.

fuelmind.frase: From the incoming NF-e to the month-end close.
fuelmind.resumo: Tracks incoming fuel deliveries and freight, along with vehicle rentals and driver payments.
fuelmind.cv: Tracks incoming fuel deliveries and freight; used daily in a real operation. Imports the NF-e (Brazilian electronic invoice, XML) and closes the month in PDF/Excel. {testes} automated tests; replaced {planilhasSubstituidas} disconnected spreadsheets.

painel.texto: Invoices for unloaded deliveries, liters, and monthly spending, all on one dashboard.

nfe.texto: Reads the NF-e (Brazilian electronic invoice) XML to record each fuel delivery.

fretes.texto: Freight month by month, with vehicle rentals and driver payments settled at month-end close.

fechamento.texto: Monthly close in PDF or Excel.

producao.texto: In production in a real operation, with {testes} automated tests. Replaced {planilhasSubstituidas} disconnected spreadsheets.

unifydata.frase: From store purchases to payroll deductions.
unifydata.resumo: Monthly close of the purchases employees make on credit at the group’s stores (gas station, restaurant, hotel), recorded in AutoSystem: it matches them against HR records and generates the payroll deduction spreadsheet.
unifydata.cv: Monthly close of employees’ credit purchases at the group’s stores, recorded in AutoSystem: matches them against HR records and generates the payroll deduction spreadsheet by company, a CSV, and an A4 report. The web version runs in production; the Python version matches by name. {testesWeb} + {testesPython} tests on GitHub Actions.

entrada.texto: The stores’ credit purchase reports are loaded alongside the HR employee records.

pendencias.texto: A purchase with no HR record or no company becomes an open item, with amount, employee ID, and store.

desconto.texto: Generates the deduction spreadsheet, one tab per company, plus a CSV and an A4 report.

versoes.texto: The web version, the one in production, matches by employee ID and also works on a phone; the Python version (Streamlit) matches by name, with human review.

alertsignal.frase: Permit and license deadlines with automatic alerts.
alertsignal.resumo: Tracks permit and license expirations for multiple companies, with daily email alerts starting {aviso1} days before each deadline and higher urgency at {aviso2} and {aviso3} days.
alertsignal.cv: Tracks permit and license expirations for multiple companies, with daily email alerts starting {aviso1} days ahead and higher urgency at {aviso2} and {aviso3}; reports in PDF, Excel, and CSV. {testes} tests on GitHub Actions.

painel.texto: Expired, due for renewal, current, and undated, with a chart of the next {meses} months.

avisos.texto: Each company lists its documents by urgency, with the expiration date and the time left. Alerts start {aviso1} days ahead, with higher urgency at {aviso2} and {aviso3}; the thresholds are configurable.

relatorio.texto: Filters by status and exports to PDF, Excel, and CSV.

artmaker.frase: Deal flyers ready for WhatsApp Status.
artmaker.resumo: Generates {formato} deal flyers sized for WhatsApp Status, in a single HTML file with Canvas; everything is saved on the device itself.
artmaker.cv: Generates {formato} deal flyers for WhatsApp Status, in a single HTML file with Canvas; saves on the device itself. The app’s default is Mercado Vitória, a real client. {testes} tests on GitHub Actions.

cliente.texto: The app’s default is Mercado Vitória.

cores.texto: Palettes appear as thumbnails, drawn by the flyer’s own rendering engine.

estilo.texto: Font, frame, border, corners, and price format, with light and dark themes.

status.texto: The flyer comes out at {formato}, with Share and Download, and stays saved on the device.

deepchat.resumo: A chat where DeepSeek answers and ChatGPT reviews the answer with a verdict, strengths, what to improve, and, when there’s an error, a revised version. No server: everything runs in the browser, and API keys, if saved, are stored encrypted.
deepchat.cv: A chat where DeepSeek answers and ChatGPT reviews the answer with a verdict and, when there’s an error, a revised version; no server, with API keys stored encrypted in the browser. Demo works without an API key; {testes} tests on GitHub Actions.

veredito.texto: Every answer gets a verdict: correct, partially correct, or incorrect.

revisada.texto: In the demo, a function that validates a CPF (Brazilian taxpayer ID) comes back partially correct because it accepts 111.111.111-11, and the review provides the corrected version.

chaves.texto: Questions go straight from the browser to the APIs, and API keys, if saved, are stored encrypted. The demo needs no key.

celular.texto: The same chat and the same review, with a layout built for phones.

praxis.frase: From request to payment, in a single flow.
praxis.resumo: Corporate purchasing from request to payment, in {etapas} stages: side-by-side quotes, approvals, installments, deadlines, and time per stage.
praxis.cv: Corporate purchasing from request to payment, in {etapas} stages: quotes, approvals, installments, deadlines, and time per stage. {perfis} access roles and {eventos} notification events; the workflow covers requester, buyer, approvers, and finance.

fluxo.texto: All {etapas} stages on a single board, with each column’s total in BRL. Each card shows the company, the amount, and how many days are left until the deadline.

cotacoes.texto: Proposals on the same screen, with price, difference from the lowest, delivery time, and terms. The recommended one is flagged.

perfis.texto: Each request shows who needs to act now and the savings compared with the most expensive proposal. The workflow covers requester, buyer, approvers, and finance, each with their own permissions.

app.texto: A PWA: the same flow on a phone, with the stages as tabs and navigation at the bottom.

audistock.frase: From the stock count to the shortage and overage report.
audistock.resumo: Inventory audits: the team counts on a phone, enters the ERP balance at closing, and gets a shortage and overage report in PDF, Excel, and CSV, with an offline queue for counting without internet.
audistock.prova: **{testesUnidade}** unit and database tests + **{testesE2e}** end-to-end on GitHub Actions
audistock.cv: Inventory audits: counting on a phone (keyboard, barcode scanner, or camera) with an offline queue, closing against the ERP balance, and a shortage and overage report in PDF, Excel, and CSV. {testesUnidade} unit and database tests and {testesE2e} end-to-end tests on GitHub Actions.

visao.texto: The progress of each count, a summary of the latest audit, and the largest shortages and overages relative to the balance.

contagem.texto: Keyboard, barcode scanner, or camera, with an offline queue for counting without internet.

relatorio.titulo: Shortages and overages against the ERP
relatorio.texto: At closing, the team enters the ERP balance. The report shows the system quantity, the counted quantity, and the difference for each item, and exports to PDF, Excel, and CSV.

flowtrack.resumo: Personal finance app with {camadas}-layer AI categorization (rules → cache → Claude Haiku); imports statements from {bancos} banks, plus OFX and CSV.
flowtrack.cv: Personal finance app with {camadas}-layer AI categorization (rules → cache → Claude Haiku); imports statements from {bancos} banks, plus OFX and CSV. {testes} automated tests.

camadas.texto: Rules first, then cache; only what is left goes to Claude Haiku.

extratos.texto: Imports statements from {bancos} banks, plus OFX and CSV files.

relatorios.texto: Income, expenses, and balance, spending by category, and the largest expenses.

docke.cv: Multi-company electronic document management: OCR, tax obligations, legal retention, and a hash-chained audit trail.
